about: HackMeridian 2026 records from HackProof (https://github.com/devodii/hackproof) at commit ea7e1982c9beea491048e668fa6dfb62a4f9a8e5, kept where the repo's own text names the event (basis repo-names-event) or HackProof lists a placement (placement-listed), with Scout's own reads of each repo and of each contract it cites, made at checkedAt. Built by scripts/build-hackmeridian-2026-hackproof.ts; refresh only through its dry run. Each row's url is its HackProof record at that commit. HackProof's license follows.
